integrity: The all-sample-size result is proved analytically. Exhaustive exact enumeration through pooled size 14 is supplementary verification and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for two independent samples from the same continuous distribution and uses the no-tie pooled-rank model.

The full text of a superficially close 2009 control-chart paper was not successfully obtained; later literature identifies its runs component as signaling rules rather than the Wald–Wolfowitz pooled-label run count.
An unindexed historical joint generating function for inversion number and symbol-run count could reduce originality.
title: Exact second-order dependence of Wald–Wolfowitz runs and Mann–Whitney rank sum
